title: OFE Newsletters Search Tool database
description: The public dataset behind the OFE Newsletters Search Tool. One row per curated newsletter item, currently sourced from the ISPA OFE Community (OFE-C) newsletter.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the file was written against, e.g. "1.0".

generatedAt.description: UTC timestamp of when this export was generated, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-09-03T20:00:00Z).

version.description: Human-facing build label for this snapshot, typically a date (e.g. 2026-09-03).

count.description: Number of entries in `items`. Must match items.length exactly, validate_data.py checks this.

id.description: Stable ID, matches the Item ID assigned in the Notion database. Never reused, never renumbered.

url.description: Best available public link: the original if live, a working replacement if not, or null if nothing publishable exists.

urlStatus.description: live = original link works. alternate = original died, a different working page is shown instead. archived = the link is a Wayback Machine copy of the original. unavailable = no working link exists; the UI should show the item without a link rather than a dead one.

publishDate.description: The date of the newsletter issue the item first appeared in.

contentType.description: Single-select, controlled vocabulary. Add a new value here (and in Notion's schema) before it can appear in an export, this is intentional, it keeps the filter list from drifting.

topics.description: Controlled multi-select, matches the Topic tags options declared in Notion.

locations.description: Open vocabulary (countries, regions, or sub-national areas). Not enum-constrained here by design, new places are expected over time; validate_data.py instead warns (not fails) on a value it hasn't seen before, so typos surface without blocking publication.

croppingSystems.description: Open vocabulary (crop or system names). Same warn-not-fail treatment as locations.

people.description: Auto-extracted people and organization names. Unreviewed draft data, expect noise (partial names, org-name fragments). Treat as a bonus search field, not an authoritative directory.

sourceNewsletter.description: Which newsletter issue this item was published in, e.g. "OFE-C Info No. 9".

newsletterNo.description: Numeric form of sourceNewsletter, used for sorting.

createdAt.description: When this record was first added to the database. For the initial 2026-09 import this equals publishDate; going forward it is set once and never changed.

updatedAt.description: When this record's data was last touched (a tag fix, a link recovery, etc.), not when the JSON file was regenerated.

publication.description: Full citation, populated only for items backed by a journal article.

expired.description: True for Job posting / Survey items whose publishDate is more than 90 days old (or that have no publishDate at all). The app hides these from the default view behind a "Show past listings" toggle; it does not remove them from the data.
